cores.name: MetaCore
cores.historicalRole: Global mesh optimization engine coordinating multi-region cryptographic evidence consensus and state verification.
cores.historicalComposition: Merkle network nodes, cryptographic proof chains, global optimization constraints.
cores.semanticTransformation: Shifted from global active optimizer to a localized presentation design specification (DESIGN_LEVEL / SANDBOX) for HASH-001 calculation.
cores.currentCapability: DESIGN_LEVEL / SANDBOX. Offline hashing helpers exist; real decentralized cryptographic consensus is absent.
cores.contradictions: Contradicts early active multi-node network claim.
cores.openQuestions: Will MetaCore remain local-only or integrate decentralized proof nodes?

cores.name: MetaForge
cores.historicalRole: Autonomic software compiler capable of live hot-swapping running systems, code synthesis, and semantic test repairs.
cores.historicalComposition: Dynamic compilation tools, semantic code analyzers, isolated sandbox nodes.
cores.semanticTransformation: Scaled back from dynamic live-modification runtime to a local compilation check / mock design node (DESIGN_LEVEL) executing commands inside a WebContainer.
cores.currentCapability: DESIGN_LEVEL / SANDBOX. UI displays active threads, but execution relies on standard WebContainer subprocess CLI commands.
cores.contradictions: Contradicts claims of fully autonomous self-correcting IDE.
cores.openQuestions: How can dynamic self-modifying sandboxes be secure from escaping boundaries?

cores.name: MetaLogos
cores.historicalTerm: MetaLogos / MetaLogos_Central / MetaLogos_AGI_Core / SCE (Semantic Cognitive Engine)
cores.historicalRole: General cognitive logic, semantic knowledge translator, and cognitive planner of LLM reasoning pathways.
cores.historicalComposition: LLM context maps, logic-tree decomposition engines, translation graphs.
cores.semanticTransformation: Standardized as a bounded conversation orchestrator and provider-agnostic agent runtime loop (ConversationProvider interfaces) rather than general semantic AGI.
cores.currentCapability: DESIGN_LEVEL (Mock local orchestration step generator exists for task planning).
cores.contradictions: Early drafts claimed general logic translation; now bounded to specific script tool sequences.
cores.openQuestions: Can MetaLogos drive multi-modal physical actions offline?

cores.name: MindState
cores.historicalRole: Tracking global user presence, emotional state vectors, location telemetry, and deep environmental metrics.
cores.historicalComposition: Presence adapters, coordinate lookups, persona context graphs.
cores.semanticTransformation: Narrowed to local offline coordinate calculation (Qibla bearing) and role switcher toolset filtering (child, adult, developer, Shura).
cores.currentCapability: LOCAL_OBSERVED (L3). Active locale (i18n, RTL) and coordinates context tracking are operational.
cores.contradictions: Early claims promised continuous sensory feedback vector arrays.
cores.openQuestions: How are private context vectors safeguarded in local edge environments?

cores.name: PrimeCore
cores.historicalTerm: PrimeCore / PrimeCore_Hybrid / Quantum_PrimeCore / Q1/Q2 / Cryptographic Intelligence Plane
cores.historicalRole: Sovereign Shariah security guardrails, TEE-secured zero-riba financial vaults, and cryptographic transaction signing.
cores.historicalComposition: Double-entry ledgers, hardware TEE attestation hooks, key rings.
cores.semanticTransformation: Transitioned from live quantum-secured hardware vault to local double-entry sandbox ledger + pre-execution fail-closed capability gates.
cores.currentCapability: LOCAL_OBSERVED (L4). Local fail-closed policy checks and mock 4-vault balances are deterministic.
cores.contradictions: Live quantum attestation is currently non-existent/simulated.
cores.openQuestions: What is the migration plan to real hardware enclave (TEE) verification?

cores.name: Archivarius
cores.historicalRole: Infinite decentralized storage architecture for tracking Merkle trees and immutable global timelines.
cores.semanticTransformation: Reduced to a local state store logging tool results and generating mock Merkle and proof references (OBSERVED).
cores.currentCapability: DESIGN_LEVEL / SANDBOX. Captures metadata proofs on memory state, lacks real decentralization or disk persistence.
cores.contradictions: Contradicts early claims of global decentralized ledger nodes.
cores.openQuestions: How will storage deal with local memory limits on large codebases?

cores.name: Singularity
cores.historicalRole: Future autonomous multi-agent coordination councils and automated Shura governance quorums.
cores.historicalComposition: Alignment algorithms, Shura voting weight matrices, future impact projections.
cores.semanticTransformation: Decomposed into local visual checkboxes for Shura signature approvals and design-level simulations.
cores.currentCoreIdentity: Singularity AI Agent & Shura Governance Engine (M07)
cores.currentCapability: DESIGN_LEVEL / SANDBOX. Visual toggles and mock governance policy evaluations only.
cores.contradictions: Contradicts claims of automated live decentralised Shura consensus.
cores.openQuestions: How will decentralized cryptographic vote signing be scaled without high latency?
